==Trivia==
*After completing [[The Feud]] quest, [[Ali the Kebab seller]] goes by the name [[Ali the Kebab seller|Isma'il The Kebab Seller]], however this clue still has the original solution of Ali the Kebab seller, but requires you to talk to Isma'il The Kebab Seller.
